LanguageData.Bloodfeed.description: Bite the target and extract their blood directly. The target will lose blood and will be horrified by the interaction, but will be otherwise unharmed. A fast-acting coagulant will seal the wound to prevent bleeding.\n\nCan only target non-vampiric humans. Blood gain is affected by the target’s body size.
LanguageData.Bloodfeed.label: drink
LanguageData.Longjump.description: Jump to a distant location using super-strong vampiric legs.
LanguageData.PiercingSpine.description: Use vampiric power to launch a bony spine at the target. The spine exits through the skin from an opening between the collarbones. Given the method of launch, it is surprisingly easy to aim.
LanguageData.VRE_AnimalFeed.description: Bite the target animal and extract their blood directly. The animal will lose blood and will be horrified by the interaction, which can result in it lashing out. A fast-acting coagulant will seal the wound to prevent bleeding.\n\nCan only target animals.
LanguageData.VRE_CorpseFeed.description: Bite the target corpse and drink whatever remains of their blood. The corpse will lose any remaining blood.\n\nCan only target human corpses.
LanguageData.VRE_Hemosmosis.description: Absorb blood that has been spilled upon the ground. Useful in the aftermath of gory battles.
LanguageData.VRE_Hemosmosis_SingleUse.description: Absorb blood that has been spilled upon the ground. Useful in the aftermath of gory battles.
LanguageData.VRE_PiercingSpine_SingleUse.description: Use vampiric power to launch a bony spine at the target. The spine exits through the skin from an opening between the collarbones. Given the method of launch, it is surprisingly easy to aim.
LanguageData.VRE_SanguoFeed.description: Bite the target vampire and drink blood from them directly. The target will lose blood and will be insulted by the interaction, but will be otherwise unharmed. A fast-acting coagulant will seal the wound to prevent bleeding.\n\nCan only target vampiric humans.
